text:
marco: Planning to publish the v1.8 release announcement tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final changelog link and stable docs URL to lock the blog and social copy.
tara: Changelog incoming. I'll add the canonical docs path and the migration note before EOD. PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/459
eli: Design needs the benchmark PNG + alt text by 17:30 to finish the hero and socials. Can someone paste the one-line benchmark claim?
sre: Short line: "~20% unit-cost improvement vs previous release; 95th-percentile latency at parity." Raw data uploaded to PR comment.
marco: We will standardize phrasing to "unit-cost improvement" across channels. No use of the word 'savings'.
tara: Canonical docs URL will be: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/v1.8/overview. Added an anchor for KV cache migration and a short runbook link.
design-bot: Noted. Please attach raw chart CSV by 15:30 so I can export sizes.
eli: Webinar links: sign-up https://redwood.com/webinar/v1-8-live, recording https://redwood.com/webinar/v1-8/recording. Include both CTAs; sign-up goes above the fold.
sre: Prod deploy plan: canary 5% -> 30% -> 100% with 15m checks. Migration note included in docs; runbook link: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/v1.8-upgrade#precheck
deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded 2024-11-05T19:45:02Z. Prod deploy scheduled 2024-11-06 08:30 PT.
crm-bot: Inbound routing configured: leads tagged 'v1_8_release' and forwarded to queue 'marketing_releases'. Webhook live.
marco: Perfect. I'll schedule publish for 09:00 PT but will only hit publish after canary reaches 30% and health checks pass. Flag any blockers here in the next hour.
tara: PR merged and docs live: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/commit/ba5e3f1.
eli: Design uploaded hero + social variants to the PR.
sre: Canary healthy at 30% after checks. No regressions observed.
marco: Publishing now and will post the announcement thread once live. Thank you everyone! :rocket:
